title: Airline industry outlook: Fuel, fares and demand shifts heading into summer
executive_summary: The airline industry is heading into the summer travel season with uncertain conditions. Geopolitics and fuel prices are affecting supply and demand. Low-cost carriers are finding success in some markets but not others. Pricing power may be impacted if fuel prices ease.

asset_allocation_views: Overweight Airlines with strong demand and pricing power
Underweight Airlines with high fuel costs and geopolitical exposure
profile_data.market_outlook: Neutral with a bias towards cautious optimism
